common.tagline: Snowbound mountain world straddling Coaxium freight routes.
hyperlanes: Coaxium freight spur off the Hydian Way
common.famousFor: Imperial Conveyex trains hauling Coaxium. Cliff-edge railroads. Failed train heists nobody admits to.
common.cantinaReputation: Frigid mountain world. Fort Ypso is a rough frontier town where smugglers, miners, and outlaws trade goods and information. The Conveyex rail system hauls coaxium through mountain passes. In 15 BBY, it's a lawless boomtown — perfect for under-the-table deals and refueling with no questions asked.
